mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_env_monitor_data (collect_id, device_id, device_type, online, collect_time, device_value, alar_status, receive_time) VALUES
( #{item.collectId}, #{item.deviceId}, #{item.deviceType}, #{item.online}, #{item.collectTime}, #{item.deviceValue}, #{item.alarStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT t.device_id AS "deviceId", t.collect_id AS "collectId", t.device_type AS "deviceType", t.online, t.collect_time AS "collectTime", t.device_value AS "deviceValue", t.alar_status AS "alarStatus" FROM ( SELECT m.id, m.device_id, m.collect_id, m.device_type, m.online, m.collect_time, m.device_value, m.alar_status, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.device_id ORDER BY m.collect_time DESC, m.id DESC) AS rn FROM wms_env_monitor_data m ) t WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.device_id
